description: This Java interface defines a generic registry for mapping commands to their corresponding exceptions within the Eclipse Ditto project. It declares a functional interface with a method to generate an exception from a given command.

classes.name: CommandToExceptionRegistry
classes.description: A functional interface that specifies a method to map commands to their respective exceptions, parameterized by command and exception types.

methods.name: exceptionFrom
methods.description: Creates and returns an exception corresponding to the provided command.
